title: Make group-chat creator bootstrap role impl-defined
description:
File: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md
Locations: lines 369, 869, 873

Three sites in the group-chat creation flow encode the same single-creator-as-admin pattern that c93e545 removed for Spaces:

- Line 369 (ChatMember.role definition): "The creator is automatically assigned the \"admin\" role."
- Line 869 (group-chat create memberIds): "ChatContact.ids of initial non-owner members."
- Line 873 (group-chat create behavior): "The server assigns the chatId (a ULID), sets the owner as an admin member, and MUST send Peer/groupUpdate to each initial member before any messages are sent."

Note: the word "owner" here is the Space-governance flavor, NOT the RFC 8620 mailbox-owner sense. Other uses of "owner" in the same draft (mailbox owner, ReadPosition owner, etc.) are correct and MUST be preserved.

Wire-interop concern is the role enum (`"admin" | "member"`) and what admins may do. *Who starts as admin* is deployment policy: a flat peer group, all-initial-admins, or single-bootstrap-admin are all viable.

Suggested wording for line 873 (paralleling the Space create text at line 1069):

  "The server assigns the chatId (a ULID), adds the creator to `members` with at least one role granting permissions sufficient to administer the chat (the specific bootstrap-role configuration is server-defined), and MUST send Peer/groupUpdate to each initial member before any messages are sent."

Suggested wording for line 869: replace "initial non-owner members" with "additional initial members".

Suggested wording for line 369: replace "The creator is automatically assigned the \"admin\" role." with a sentence noting the bootstrap-role assignment is server-defined, or just drop the trailer (the role enum and admin-action list are independent of how seats are assigned at creation).
acceptance_criteria:
- Line 369: no normative single-principal bootstrap statement remains
- Line 869: no use of "non-owner" remains
- Line 873: bootstrap-role assignment wording is server-defined, paralleling the Space create wording at line 1069
- After the edit, grep -ni '\\bowner\\b' on the main draft returns only mailbox-owner-sense matches (RFC 8620 principal, federation OwnerInfo, ReadPosition owner, etc.) — no group-chat-governance matches remain
- The Authorization section (lines ~1396-1403) remains untouched
